axisDefinitions.ten: A desired result controls the steps.
Updates produce new values and preserve old values.

axisDefinitions.zero: One local instance performs the work.
axisDefinitions.ten: Multiple network nodes coordinate the work.
Runtime commands can change system behavior.

axisDefinitions.zero: A managed interface hides machine details.
axisDefinitions.ten: The system defines or directly controls hardware.

axisDefinitions.zero: One general artifact serves many tasks.
axisDefinitions.ten: The build selects components for a specific task.
Durable state is a principal system function.

method: Manual estimates from the cited sources. Scores describe the stated scope, not code quality or measured performance.
uncertainty: A score of 5 can mark uncertain evidence, as its reason states. Review those scores before a substantive conclusion.
compatibility: These study axes do not replace user axes. Joint PCA requires paradigm scores on these exact axis definitions.

repos.name: GHCi
repos.scope: One local GHCi session with Haskell expressions and IO actions. External services and foreign code lie outside this scope.

repos.name: Gforth

paradigms.name: Ownership types
paradigms.definition: The compiler checks one owner per value and releases the value when its owner leaves scope.

Values leave memory when their owners leave scope. Durable storage is outside this model.
